Submission.description: Non-native envelope rows retain nullable SQL invoice_no and unrestricted stored status; native history verified by state(), source hash, ledger/environment/company binding. Native status derived: delivered=>acknowledged; document-not-valid/unable-to-deliver/unknown-server-error=>failed; other with ID=>prepared; no ID=>uncertain. All are outer HTTP200 ok:true, not delivery assertions. duplicate false only initial reserve/original completed dispatch.

ReceiveBody.description: Direct serde struct sequence requires all seven declared fields, Option fields explicit null in sequence; maps may omit Option fields. IngestOptions default bool allows omitted sequence tail. companyKey/maxTimestamp nonempty trimmed no control <=512/128 UTF8 bytes. Default limit=maxPages=100. Workspace additionally compares raw Value to exact {confirm:true}, so arrays never admitted there.

const.description: Original flat write; confirm:true required. Limits: 1MiB MCP frame, 16KiB native body, 16MiB response. Explicit company slug only: no filesystem selectors/local DB fallback or automatic actor. Authority comes only from current human cookie, fresh MFA and CompanyExternalSend; Bearer/service credentials refused. Both selectors preserved, documentId takes precedence without fallback. ok:true with status prepared or uncertain does not necessarily mean delivered. No automatic retry, status loop or readback; after unknown reconcile existing public_invoice_submissions before another deliberate action. Canonical native evidence is retained, not claimed byte-identical legacy output. PEPPOL endpointUrl is metadata only: NO FETCH, credential transport or automatic delivery. Caller acknowledgement is an attestation, not a provider receipt. Natural dedup excludes URL/acknowledgement; replay returns the original submission.
const.name: peppol_submit_public_invoice

const.description: Original flat write; confirm:true required. Limits: 1MiB MCP frame, 16KiB native body, 16MiB response. Explicit company slug only: no filesystem selectors/local DB fallback or automatic actor. Authority comes only from current human cookie, fresh MFA and CompanyExternalSend; Bearer/service credentials refused. Both selectors preserved, documentId takes precedence without fallback. ok:true with status prepared or uncertain does not necessarily mean delivered. No automatic retry, status loop or readback; after unknown reconcile existing public_invoice_submissions before another deliberate action. Canonical native evidence is retained, not claimed byte-identical legacy output. Digisense uses existing operator configuration/registration only; supplied digisenseCompanyKey is an equality assertion, never configuration. accessPoint is forbidden. Queued submission may make one status observation; terminal/uncertain/history NEVER cause redelivery. efaktura_status and secret configuration are outside this package and remain issue717 scope.

const.description: Status only for an accepted native Digisense submission; never delivers or reserves delivery. Acknowledged receipts are cached without provider I/O; nonterminal observations return ok:false. Explicit company slug and current human cookie, fresh MFA, CompanyExternalSend and current ledger binding required. Optional digisenseCompanyKey is an assertion, not configuration. One status observation at most; no retry, readback or status loop. Native evidence retained; 16KiB body and 16MiB response limits.
const.name: efaktura_status
